title: Ride the best wave in Kelowna with Msurf Okanagan!
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the Best Wave on Okanagan Lake. We don’t drive to the beach to catch a wave, we create our own endless wave right here on beautiful Okanagan Lake. We are the most diversified wake surf school in the Okanagan offering lessons on the Competition class Super Nautique G23, which can create a surf wake that extends as far as 25 feet behind the boat supported by a state-of-the-art sound system. 
We also offer boat charters and teaching on your boat. All gear is included. Our Charter service is a safe and relaxing way to experience the Okanagan from the lake perspective with Wakesurf Lessons for any expertise level you have.
